{{Top|ga}} {{Otheruses|Mika}} {{Location |image=[[File:MikasTent-KazsCurse.png]] |name=Mika's tent |created= |destroyed= |type=[[Tent]]{{Resistance|Kaz's Curse}} |location=[[Colossus marketplace|''Colossus'' marketplace]], ''[[Colossus]]'' |terrain= |fauna= |flora= |interest= |affiliation= }} {{Quote|What knowledge do you seek?''"
"''Uh, well, I—I wanna know how long I'm going to live. Will I survive this war?''"
"''Like so many that come to me for clarity, I can only offer but a glimpse into your future.|Mika Grey and Bolza Grool|audio=MikasTent-KazsCurse.flac|}} '''Mika's tent''', also known as '''Mika's stall''', was a stall run by the [[archaeologist]] [[Mika Grey]] within the [[Colossus marketplace|marketplace]] of the [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]''. In the [[tent]], Grey operated as a [[prophet]] and offered [[Fortune teller|fortune telling]] services to her customers, advising them based on their desires and fears. In [[34 ABY]], the [[gorgmonger]] [[Bolza Grool]] visited the tent wanting to know if he would survive the ongoing [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] within [[the galaxy]]. Afterward, the [[Resistance]] member [[Kazuda Xiono]] visited the stall after the [[Warbird gang|pirate]] [[Leoz]] had supposedly [[Aka Du|cursed]] him. ==Description== Mika's tent,{{SW|url=kaz-s-curse-episode-gallery|text="Kaz's Curse" Episode Gallery}} {{C|Slide 7}} also known as Mika's stall, was located near the middle{{SW|url=kaz-s-curse-concept-art-gallery|text="Kaz's Curse" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slides 10 and 11}} of the [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]''{{'s}} [[Colossus marketplace|marketplace]]. The [[tent]]'s worn, [[Color|multicolored]] roof and entry fabrics featured at least two symbols on its outside, various styles of patterning, and repair patches. The tent's interior was primarily constructed of maroon-colored textiles and gray framing. From the outside, the stall's structure material was held up by gray suspending poles and cables. The tent contained a low table, two patterned rugs, two maroon seat cushions, and a small cloth-covered station in one of its corners. Multiple [[lantern]]s hanging from the stall's side wall cables lit the tent's space. ==History== {{Quote|I've heard of many things. A large part of a curse will come down to how much you believe in it or not. And from what it seems, you believe in it more than you are letting on.|Mika Grey, to Kazuda Xiono|audio=MikasTent2-KazsCurse.flac|}} [[File:MikaGreyBolzaGrool-KazsCurse.png|thumb|right|280px|Bolza Grool visited Mika's tent to see if he would survive the ongoing war in the galaxy.]] In [[34 ABY]],{{ResistanceDate|2|10}} after she was invited onto the ''Colossus'' by some of its residents, the [[archaeologist]]{{Resistance|The Relic Raiders}} [[Mika Grey]] began operating a tent where she worked as a [[prophet]] and [[fortune teller]] to the superstitious residents of the [[Supertanker fuel depot|station]].{{Databank|mika-grey|Mika Grey}} That [[Standard year|year]], the [[gorgmonger]]''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' [[Bolza Grool]] visited Grey as he{{Databank|bolza-grool|Bolza Grool}} wanted to know if he would survive the ongoing [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] throughout [[the galaxy]]. Before speaking with the [[Klatooinian]], the archaeologist stood at the entrance of her tent and watched the [[Resistance]] member [[Kazuda Xiono]] and the [[Technician|mechanic]] [[Neeku Vozo]] walk in the marketplace talking about a [[Aka Du|curse]] supposedly placed on the former by the [[Kajain'sa'Nikto]] [[Warbird gang|Warbird]] [[pirate]] [[Leoz]]. Grey then made her way into the tent, where she informed Grool that his future included many tiny and sharp [[Tooth|teeth]], which the [[merchant]] took to mean that the [[gorg]]s he [[Currency|sold]] would [[Diet|eat]] him. After Grey was unable to specify if it was the case, he pleaded with her to tell him more. However, when the fortune teller refused, Grool [[Galactic Credit Standard|paid]] her and left the tent. [[File:MikasTentKazEntering-KazsCurse.png|thumb|left|280px|Kazuda Xiono visited Mika's tent to seek the fortune teller's advice about supposed curse he had received.]] A short while later, Xiono and Vozo made their way to Mika's stall on the suggestion of the latter to talk about the curse that had supposedly been placed on the former. After Xiono arrived, Grey took a [[boot]] of credits he had brought with him as payment and reassured the [[pilot]] that a large part of any curse came down to how much it was believed in, adding that she thought he believed in the curse more than he wanted to admit. The archaeologist suggested that Xiono take a lucky charm to defend against the curse and gave him a [[Kaz's talisman|talisman]] she had acquired on her travels, which she claimed could ward off evil energy. Xiono accepted the talisman and left the stall. Not long after, the [[Frigosian]] [[janitor]] [[Opeepit]]{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-fuel-for-the-fire-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 10 Fun Facts from "Fuel for the Fire" - ''Star Wars Resistance''|date=2022-10-22}} visited the stall. Grey and the Frigosian departed from the tent after some [[time]], with the latter holding his head down as Xiono approached Grey, who had seemingly overcome the curse placed on him. The same year,{{ResistanceDate|2|16}} as [[Imanuel Doza]], the [[captain]] of the ''Colossus'', gave the [[Unidentified Aeosian Queen|Queen]] of the [[planet]] [[Aeos Prime]] a tour of the [[Space station|station's]] marketplace, the pair walked past the tent.{{Resistance|No Place Safe}} ==Behind the scenes== Mika's tent first appeared, albeit unidentified, in "[[Kaz's Curse]]," the tenth episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', which aired on [[December 8]], [[2019]].{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}} It was identified as Mika's tent and Mika's stall in the corresponding episode guide. Concept art illustrations of the tent were completed by [[Lucasfilm Animation]]'s [[Jim Moore]] on [[April 6]], [[2018]]. ===Concept art gallery=== {{Gallery |source=''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' |storyboards= |concept= File:MikasTent-ConceptArt1.jpg|vndStallMika 1 of 2, Jim Moore File:MikasTent-ConceptArt2.jpg|vndStallMika 2 of 2, Jim Moore |digital= |in-progress= }} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Mika's tent}} *{{Resistance|Kaz's Curse}} {{1st}} *{{Resistance|No Place Safe}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/star-wars-resistance/kaz-s-curse-episode-guide|text="Kaz's Curse" Episode Guide | Star Wars Resistance}} {{1stID|Mika's tent and Mika's stall}} *{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-kazs-curse-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 4 Fun Facts from "Kaz's Curse" - ''Star Wars Resistance''}} {{Po}} *{{Databank|mika-grey|Mika Grey}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Businesses]] [[Category:Colossus locations]]
